zh-TW.title: 數字字母切換（Number-Letter）
zh-TW.description: 字母數字組合出現在畫面四格之一：上半部判斷數字奇偶，下半部判斷字母是子音或母音，練習在兩種規則間切換。

en.title: Number-Letter Task
en.description: A letter-number pair appears in one of four boxes: judge the number as odd or even in the top half and the letter as consonant or vowel in the bottom half, to practise switching between two rules.
